ABOUT ME

✷

Curious Driven Ecclectic Collaborative Creative Accountable

A dev with a playful, illustrative approach. My view of the world has always been one of looking for patterns, lovingly filing things into boxes. A fascination with design and how we can interact with it is somewhat of a natural extension of that to me.

My first foray into web in particular began at a young age, Frankensteining together bits of others' code on Neopets for my pet pages. It had such a grip on me, I could make these incredible interactive worlds filled with my art, my writing, if I could just learn how to talk to the computer!

With a few self-printed book projects under my belt after graduating college, I jumped into my first graphic design job and had a blast with the range of material I got to work on, from billboards to business cards. Web stayed in my peripheries all the while though, and a few tutorials later and I was hooked all over again.

So off I sped into a six month crash course on the MERN stack. Even five years in, I never know enough! PHP, templating languages, headless CMSes, email design, CRMs, new libraries, new utilities! If I see a site I like, my dev tools are open! There's always something new to add to my repertoire. Finding challenges I get to solve with creativity, empathy for others, and an eye for beauty are what make web perhaps the perfect fit for me.
